title: Implement bounded worker BM25 retrieval with parity checks
note: Native proposal validation, accepted merge and task completion remain separate required gates. This receipt does not mark the backlog complete.
known_limitations: This receipt is not a native completion or merge receipt.
src/lib/worldwide/search/bm25.ts, src/workers/worldwideSearchWorker.ts, and tests/worldwide/bm25-parity.test.ts are untracked working-tree files. site_revision is HEAD before those edits.
artifacts/ is gitignored, so this receipt is on disk and is not part of git status. Its own sha256 is not stored inside this file.

Scores follow country_laws_ir bm25.score_query at commit 2ea4ca6804b3c4cc44e43d0539f4c3fcae011747. A repeated query token adds the term again. DuckDB bm25_search keeps one contribution per distinct term.
Equal scores keep the first document that received a contribution. That is score_query's stable sort. DuckDB orders those ties by document_index.
A query term outside every inclusive route is not searched. query.py reads every posting shard when no range matches. This reader does not.
k1, b, title weight, and body weight are pinned to 1.2, 0.75, 5, and 1. average_document_length comes from the index. A missing or non-positive average becomes 1.
The reader uses the stored idf and document length. Term frequency is title_weight times the title count plus body_weight times the body count.

A traversal budget stops before the next posting entry. A memory budget stops before the next posting record, counted as the canonical JSON byte size of that record. Earlier contributions remain. Default caps are 50000 entries and 8 MiB, with a ceiling of 200000 entries and 32 MiB.
Routed shards must carry a sha256 of their record array. Flat postings have no shard checksum. topK is an integer from 1 to 100 and defaults to 10. Query tokens are sliced at 64.

The worker scores off the caller stack. A handled search error is returned as ok:false and the port stays open. A port error or a silent port is terminated so the caller is not left waiting. The default yield is a zero-delay timer every 128 applied entries, so a cancel flag is observed on that boundary and on every budget check.

Jest's jsdom environment does not provide a dedicated Worker. The failure tests drive the client through an in-process port. The dedicated-worker listener is installed only when globalThis is a WorkerGlobalScope.

The parity test runs /usr/bin/python3.12 -I. That process is a stdlib transcription of score_query. It does not import country_laws_ir, numpy, or pandas. Its ranks match scores previously captured from bm25.score_query on the pinned file.
